name: 复活节花园
description: 十六幅春天图画：小兔、彩蛋篮、破壳小鸡、彩绘蛋、小羊、郁金香、小鸭、蝴蝶、胡萝卜地、寻找彩蛋、孵蛋的母鸡、春日花环、蜗牛、蜜蜂和彩蛋气球。
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no fur, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly spring subject, centered, in a simple garden with big flowers and painted eggs. About 16 large closed areas to color. Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.
